name: Dual Isosurfacing with Analytical Trilinear Intersection
definition: A method to determine the topology of an analytical isosurface within a voxel by using the trilinear function exhaustively for all possible configurations, optimizing ray casting to find one intersection point per disjoint isosurface component.
summary: Dual Isosurfacing with Analytical Trilinear Intersection extracts topologically accurate isosurfaces by using analytical ray intersection to resolve ambiguous configurations, unlike standard Marching Cubes.
